widget.successFeedback: Five — feathers and pebbles pair off exactly, because 5 names one amount everywhere.

cml.actionGoal: Pair the groups one to one, or place both numbers in the counting song, for kcm same numeral.
invariants: Comparison rests on two facts that never move: pairing one to one leaves the bigger group with leftovers, and a number later in the counting song always names more — which is what kcm same numeral uses.
misconceptions: Judging by how much space a group fills, by the size of the things in it, or by which number was written first.
cml.counterfactualPrompt: If one more joined the smaller group, would the pairing come out even?

widget.prompt: 5 pebbles and 5 feathers — which group has more things?

options.label: The feathers, because they spread out
options.feedback: Spreading fills space without adding members; both groups pair off exactly.
